title: Bucket Brigades: Uniqueness of the Fixed Point and Three-Worker Asymptotics
summary: A standard organization of production lines exhibiting self-balancing behavior is given by bucket brigades. Their study in operations research was initiated by the foundational work of Bartholdi and Eisenstein ({\em Operations Research}, 1996), where a simplified version of the model is considered. Their main result shows that when workers are ordered from the slowest to the fastest, the system is stable and converges to a ``fixed point,'' where each worker oscillates between two limiting positions.
